title: Quick Shattering Gujarati Gherkin Dumplings
description: Sour, shattering brunch dumplings inspired by gulab jamun, packed with fresh gherkin relish and deglazed with a low‑sodium tang.
instructions: Heat oil in a deep pan over medium heat until shimmering.
Add cumin and fennel seeds and wait for them to crackle.
Stir in gram flour and toast it for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in yogurt slowly while whisking to keep the batter smooth.
Add ginger garlic paste, chaat masala, low sodium salt, lemon juice, and coriander, mixing until the dough is cohesive.
Drop spoonfuls of dough into the hot oil, shaping them into round dumplings and fry until golden on all sides.
Remove dumplings with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Add a splash of water to the remaining oil to deglaze, scraping up any brown bits for flavor.
Return the dumplings to the pan and simmer in the deglazed sauce for 2 minutes to coat.
Serve hot as a brunch treat, optionally drizzled with a squeeze of fresh lemon.
